artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a finite group $G$, let $\psi_G$ denote the character of the action of $G$ on itself by conjugation; that is, $\psi_G$ is the character of the permutation representation $\rho\colon G\to S_G$ defined by $\rho(x)(y)=xyx^{-1}$, where $S_G$ is the symmetric group on the set $G$. For each integer $n\ge 1$ and each partition $\lambda$ of $n$, let $\chi^\lambda$ be the irreducible character of the symmetric group $S_n$ indexed by $\lambda$, and define
$$\kappa_{n,\lambda}\;=\;\langle \psi_{S_n},\,\chi^\lambda\rangle,$$
the multiplicity of $\chi^\lambda$ in the conjugation character of $S_n$. It is known that $\kappa_{n,\lambda}>0$ for all partitions $\lambda$ of $n$, with the sole exception $(n,\lambda)=(2,(1,1))$. Equivalently, $\kappa_{n,\lambda}$ equals the row sum corresponding to $\lambda$ in the character table of $S_n$.

Find a combinatorial interpretation of the numbers $\kappa_{n,\lambda}$: that is, exhibit an explicit family of combinatorial objects indexed by $(n,\lambda)$ whose cardinality equals $\kappa_{n,\lambda}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a long-standing open problem (Stanley's Exercise 7.71(e) in Enumerative Combinatorics, vol. 2, also listed as Stanley's Problem 12 on positivity/combinatorial interpretations). Although positivity of these row sums of the character table of $S_n$ is established and partial results exist (e.g., work of Scharf, Adin–Postnikov–Roichman, and the 2017 paper by Sundaram on the conjugacy action of $S_n$ and modules induced from centralisers), no general combinatorial interpretation of $\kappa_{n,\lambda}$ is known.

status_evidence.title: The conjugacy action of S_n and modules induced from centralisers
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the conjugation representation of S_n and decomposition into irreducibles, citing Stanley's open problem on combinatorial interpretation of the multiplicities.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work investigates the decomposition of the conjugation character of S_n but does not provide a general combinatorial interpretation, indicating the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Character Polynomials and Row Sums of the Symmetric Group
status_evidence.snippet: The problem of finding a combinatorial interpretation of the row sums of the character table of S_n was posed by Stanley as Problem 12; these sums are the multiplicities of irreducibles in the conjugation character.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is identified as an open problem of Stanley.
